Leopard seals are a large species of seals, often growing up to ten feet long. They're the only species of seal known to pursue humanoids. **[Recall Knowledge - Animal](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 19 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 17 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 14 [Leopard Seal](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3306) **Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 178 **Perception** +13; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 40 feet, whisker sense 60 feet **Languages** **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) +8, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) +14, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) +10 **Str** +6 **Dex** +4 **Con** +3 **Int** -4 **Wis** +1 **Cha** +2 **Deep Breath** A leopard seal can hold its breath for 30 minutes.
**Protective Blubber** A leopard seal treats [environmental cold effects](/Rules.aspx?ID=642) as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).
Whisker Sense A leopard seal can use its whiskers to sense vibrations as a [precise sense](/Rules.aspx?ID=411) at the listed range, but only underwater. --- **AC** 20 **Fort** +12 **Ref** +14 **Will** +8 **HP** 65 --- **Speed** 15 feet, swim 40 feet **Melee** jaws +12, **Damage** 2d8+6 piercing plus [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45) **Melee** tail +12 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170)), **Damage** 2d6+6 bludgeoning **[Aquatic Ambush](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=51)** 50 feet. **Predatory Slam** **Requirements** The leopard seal is in water; **Effect** The leopard seal travels up to 40 feet, ending its movement on land. Enemies adjacent to the leopard seal when it ends its movement take 2d10 bludgeoning damage (DC 21 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save) and are knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88) on a failure.
